# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Locate the closest building ordinance (i.e., Federal A.D.A.)
3. Search the specific and closest individual item of failure
4. Document the individual items failure using the BRC BMP (Building Remodeling Checklist Best Management Practice) forms.
5. Document the failed element fully in the narrative with location, material, and size.
6. Prepare a visual (photo or sketch) of the failed element.
7. Follow the flow chart to solve the problem.

## Locate the closest building ordinance (i.e., Federal A.D.A.)

- First look at the Federal Building A.D.A. requirements.
- Then look at the State, County and Municipal requirements for any modifications needed.
- Then look to the Federal Section 504, 101 & 202 and the Rehabilitation Act for education oriented modifications to the standard.
- Last look to the Fair Housing Act of 19
